answer: The system rents access to its haven to one identity only after that identity locks 50 units for 90 days, so 100 fake identities must lock 5,000 units separately with no sharing. Each month, it pays rent by delivering one walnut weighing at least 12 grams and one sable hair measuring at least 3 centimeters, and both items are stored under that identity for the full 90 days so neither can pay rent for a second identity. If a monthly delivery is missing or under weight or length, access ends and the 50 units stay locked for 30 more days.
